fraud.text:
(xi) Frauds:	
A. During the course of our examinations of the books & records of the Company, carried out in accordance with the generally accepted auditing practices in lndia & according to the information & explanations given to us, no fraud by the Company and no material fraud on the Company has been noticed or reported during the year.							
B	As per the information and explanation given to us and during the course of audit, no report under sub-section (12) of section 143 of the Companies Act, 2013 has been filed in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government, during the year and upto the date of this report.							
C	As represented to us by the management, there are no whistle blower complaints received by the company during the year.

business_summary.text: Belrise Industries (formerly Badve Engineering) makes safety-critical automotive systems such as chassis, exhaust systems, BIW parts, suspensions and steering columns for 2W, 3W, 4W and CV OEMs, and is expanding into defence and aerospace.

call_points.text: Hyva India's tipper business, adding Pune, Jamshedpur and Bengaluru facilities, is expected to complete in Q3 FY27.
Adding a brownfield set-up for a US solar tracker OEM, supplying sheet-metal assemblies for 2.5 GW annually.
Management expects to continue delivering mid-teens revenue growth and stable EBITDA margins for FY27.
Capex is expected to remain in the range of 6% to 6.5% of manufacturing revenue.

guidance.statement: Belrise aims to grow its 4W/CV segment revenue by 40-45% in FY27
We expect to continue delivering mid-teens revenue growth, consistent with our track record and momentum in our order book.
Belrise aims to grow its 4W/CV segment revenue by 40-45% in FY27 from the FY25 base.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Auto Components > Auto Components & Equipments

operating_notes.text: Total manufacturing plants increased to 24 in FY26 from 17 in FY25.
Acquired Chester Hall Precision Engineering in the UK during Q4 FY26 for aerospace expansion.
Manufacturing revenue was ₹2,198 Cr in Q1FY27, up 20%, while trading revenue fell 19% to ₹348.6 Cr.
Exports were 12.7% of manufacturing revenue in Q1FY27, down from 13.8% in Q1FY26.
The company has 38 manufacturing facilities across 13 cities in 10 states and 3 countries, with 90,000+ MTPA annual production capacity.

timeline.summary: Belrise Industries submitted the monitoring agency report for Q4 FY26 detailing IPO proceeds utilisation.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,552.83 Cr (+12.2% YoY), net profit ₹130.23 Cr (+18.4% YoY).
Belrise Industries reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,553 Cr (+12.2% YoY) and FY26 revenue of ₹9,509 Cr.
Belrise Industries board approved a QIP fundraise of up to ₹2,000 Cr.
Belrise Industries reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹9,509.10 Cr and PAT of ₹496.86 Cr.
Belrise Industries Limited held earnings call on May 25, 2026, at 11:00 AM (IST) with recording available on the company’s website.
Belrise Industries reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,553 Cr (+12% YoY) and discussed growth plans across auto components and aerospace.
Shrikant Shankar Badve (Promoter) and Sumedh Shrikant Badve (Promoter) declared no share encumbrances for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on April 6, 2026.
